intro: For companies that want a building ready to operate, built to their specifications — with the flexibility to buy it or lease it.
description: We design and build your building to fit — from 200,000 to 750,000 square feet — with the infrastructure, dock doors and layout defined around your process.
headline: A BUILDING MADE FOR YOUR OPERATION. BUY IT OR LEASE IT.

buy.title: IF YOU BUY
buy.text: You turn the building into long-term equity, with full control over an asset that appreciates in the Northeast's premier industrial corridor.

lease.title: IF YOU LEASE
lease.text: You occupy the building without tying up capital, keeping it where it earns the most: your machinery, your inventory, your people. Maximum flexibility and a fast start-up.

feature1.title: BUILT TO FIT
feature1.text: Clear height, dock doors, ramps, offices, power and layout defined around your process.

feature2.title: SCHEDULED DELIVERY
feature2.text: Clear dates from contract signing. Your start-up plan doesn't depend on promises.

feature3.title: INSTITUTIONAL TERMS
feature3.text: USD contracts, structured for long-term operations.

feature4.title: PLANNED GROWTH
feature4.text: Buildings prepared for expansion within the same park.
